metadata.title: ISO/IEC 42001:2023 Profile
metadata.remarks: Resolves the Living Control Set into the ISO/IEC 42001:2023 (AI management system) view. Named honestly as a forward target: the AIMS layer is emerging and this profile demonstrates alignment, not certification. AAT-01 maps to clauses 5.1 and 8.1 and Annex A controls A.2.2 and A.6.2.2.
